tweets.text:
We're COOKED!

I’ve always thought the hardest part of creating isn’t having an idea.

It’s getting what’s in your head to actually look the way you imagined it.

You know the shot.
You know the angle.
You know how the scene should feel.

But somehow, you end up generating version after version, hoping one of them finally gets close.

That’s what stood out to me here.

Seeing 3D used as a way to actually shape the camera and scene before bringing generative AI into the mix feels different.

You’re not just waiting to see what the model gives you.

You’re directing the idea.

And watching how far these creative workflows are already moving…

Yeah, we're COOKED 👀

Friar also said OpenAI’s annualized revenue run rate increased 20% from June to July, signaling continued acceleration in the company’s overall business. tweets.text:
Scammers are getting craftier, but our seniors are getting smarter.
 
Our officers have been working hard to educate people on common scams, and this includes visiting our local senior centers to make sure they have the most up-to-date information to protect them from getting ripped off. Here are the most common rackets we see:
 
Jury duty scams: We will never call you demanding payment or personal information because you missed jury duty. If someone threatens you with arrest unless you pay immediately, hang up.
 
AI family voice scams: Scammers can now use artificial intelligence to clone the voices of your friends and family. If someone calls claiming to be a loved one in an emergency and urgently needs money or information, take a moment to verify who you’re really talking to.
 
Unexpected links: Be cautious about clicking links you weren’t expecting, even if the message appears to come from someone you know or a trusted organization.
 
Scammers want you to panic and act quickly without asking questions. Taking a few minutes to slow down and verify the information might just save you from a scam.
 
Share this with a parent, grandparent, or loved one. It might help them from becoming a victim.
